calls.head: Detroit can’t afford to take penalties
calls.body: NY Rangers’s power play creates 7.8 expected goals per 60, 9th in the league. Detroit’s penalty kill ranks 23rd.
calls.call: NY Rangers’s power play creates at least its usual 7.8 expected goals per 60.

calls.head: Forecheck against patience
calls.body: On forecheck pressure, NY Rangers sits 2nd of 32, at the hounding end of the scale. Detroit is 30th, at the passive end.
calls.call: NY Rangers puts more forecheck pressure on than Detroit.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 0 games this season
calls.happened: On forecheck score (arena-adjusted, 100 is league average), NY Rangers had 128 and Detroit 148. Coming in, NY Rangers was at 121 and Detroit at 84.

DET.head: We gave Detroit a 64% chance, but NY Rangers had other ideas.

NYR.head: We gave NY Rangers a 36% chance, and NY Rangers proved us wrong.

surprises.head: NY Rangers shut down Detroit’s power play
surprises.body: Detroit’s power play created 3.0 expected goals per 60, against its usual 8.6 and a league average of 7.6. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 30 games.

surprises.head: Detroit brought the hits
surprises.body: Detroit’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 131, against its usual 83 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 15 games.
